assessment.headline: DAY 36. Two US planes down. Crew member MISSING in Iran. The war just changed fundamentally.
assessment.body:
The war crossed a new threshold overnight. Two US aircraft were downed in a single day — the biggest US military loss since the war began:

1. F-15E Strike Eagle SHOT DOWN OVER IRAN. One crew member rescued. One still MISSING — search ongoing. If captured by Iran, this becomes a POW crisis that could extend the war by months.

2. A-10 Warthog hit by Iranian air defenses NEAR THE STRAIT OF HORMUZ. Pilot ejected and was rescued. The shootdown near Hormuz means combat is intensifying around the very chokepoint India depends on.

Trump's response was not de-escalation. He posted: 'We haven't even started destroying what's left in Iran. Bridges next, then Electric Power Plants!' This is the clearest signal yet that April 6 = power plant strikes BEGIN, not resume.

Meanwhile, strikes hit on BOTH sides' industrial base: Israel struck Mobarakeh Steel, Khuzestan Steel (IRGC-linked), yellowcake plant in Yazd, and Arak heavy-water reactor. Iran hit Kuwait's Mina al-Ahmadi refinery, UAE steel plants, Bahrain aluminum, and Rafael arms factories in Israel. A cluster bomb killed 1 in Ramat Gan.

The White House requested a $1.5 TRILLION defense budget — a 40% increase. This is permanent war infrastructure, not '2-3 weeks.'

For India (Day 36, 8:15 AM):
• Markets closed (weekend). Reopen Monday INTO April 6 deadline
• Two US planes down will shock markets globally Monday
• If F-15 crew is POW → war extends indefinitely → oil spikes → Sensex crash
• Brent $109. Indian basket likely $120+. Rupee 93.19 (RBI holding)
• 60 days fuel stock. LPG 30+ days. 800 TMT cargoes. Op Urja Suraksha active
• India in 60+ nation Hormuz coalition. Supplying fuel to 5 neighbors
• A-10 was shot down NEAR HORMUZ — combat zone around India's energy lifeline

The next 48 hours:
• Saturday: UN Hormuz vote (likely vetoed)
• Sunday: April 6 deadline EXPIRES (8 PM ET = Monday 5:30 AM IST)
• Monday: Indian markets reopen into potentially the worst open of the war

The missing F-15 crew member is now the most important person in the world. If alive in Iranian hands — Trump cannot exit. If dead — domestic pressure mounts. Either way, '2-3 weeks' is no longer credible. India must prepare for a war that could last months.
